szenen.text: A viral post says the whole market is doomed. Real or panic? We checked.
True: Democrats won Congress, and the US Iran war keeps oil near 100 dollars. Yields are up, but not exploding.
Wrong: Nvidia is down 27 percent, not 40. No proof that Japan and China dump Treasuries. And biggest crash in history? Just panic.
Our view: no panic, but real risk. A broader selloff across stocks, bonds and crypto has become more likely. Follow for facts, not fear.
